summary: Completed the first scenario-complete Corsair Gaming common-stock review using current SEC primary evidence and the canonical 2026-08-04 upper-Bollinger trigger. The deterministic assessment recorded a Hold research rating, Watch portfolio action, 64 quality, medium confidence, and USD 6.00/USD 11.25/USD 18.00 bear/base/bull fair values with USD 11.625 probability-weighted fair value against USD 11.369999885559082. Allocation remains ineligible because expected return, base return, bear/base and expected/bear payoff, margin of safety, and the accepted-relationship gate do not pass; no conviction strategy, signal, paper order, issue, or follow-up operation was created.

evidence.claim: Corsair's SEC quarterly report for Q1 2026 reported USD 354.5 million revenue, USD 116.0 million gross profit, USD 13.8 million operating income, USD 12.8 million net income attributable to Corsair, USD 29.7 million operating cash flow, USD 119.7 million cash and restricted cash, USD 119.8 million total debt, USD 273.5 million inventory, and 107.8 million diluted weighted-average shares.

The SEC-filed issuer release reported 32.7% Q1 gross margin and USD 35.8 million adjusted EBITDA, guided Q2 to USD 295-320 million revenue and USD 12.5-15.5 million adjusted EBITDA, and left full-year 2026 guidance unchanged at USD 1.33-1.47 billion revenue, USD 100-115 million adjusted EBITDA, and USD 0.58-0.74 non-GAAP EPS.

The canonical alert measured a 27.90% adjusted-close increase from 2026-07-07 through 2026-08-04 to USD 11.37 and a close 0.92% above the USD 11.2660 upper Bollinger band; RSI was 65.97 and volume was not anomalous. The review treated this as stronger expectations and timing risk rather than verified improvement in intrinsic value.

Deterministic assessment version 2 derived USD 11.625 probability-weighted fair value, 2.2427% expected return, 1.6821% confidence-adjusted expected return, USD 9 buy-below price, -1.0667% margin of safety, Hold canonical rating, Watch portfolio action, Watch conviction tier, and allocation ineligibility with complete threshold-frontier reasons.
